rubrics.justification: Mostly consistent with a good-quality blastocyst and dense ICM, but it overstates confidence in A-grade TE and mentions thinning/partial opening of the zona and higher expansion features that are not clearly evident from this single image.
Thoroughly integrates age, ovarian reserve, BMI, smoking, endometrium, semen parameters, diagnosis, and cycle history with embryo quality and prognosis.
Reasoning is logical and well structured, with probability estimates tied to embryo quality and patient factors; minor issue is some inconsistency around exact expansion-stage nomenclature.

Generally aligned with Gardner grading principles and standard IVF counseling, including SET recommendation and caution that morphology does not predict ploidy; slight overreach in image-based grading certainty prevents a perfect score.
Provides clear practical recommendations for proceeding with transfer, smoking cessation, peri-transfer optimization, and SET, though future cycle planning is only briefly addressed.
